Cheers.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is small update that adds support for [url=https://www.amd.com/en/technologies/fidelityfx-super-resolution]FSR[/url]. I noticed that some AMD players were getting some performance problems, so I hope this feature helps. 
You can enable this by going to options -> Advanced -> FSR and choose the option that best suits you.
Users with RTX cards won't see this option as DLSS is already supported by the game.

Cheers.
